home.metaTitle: OmniFit — Coaching platform for independent coaches
home.metaDescription: Invite-only coaching workspace for programming, logging, messaging, and payments — Free up to 3 clients, Pro at $29/mo.

legal.privacyMeta: How OmniFit collects, uses, and protects personal data.
legal.termsMeta: Terms governing use of the OmniFit coaching platform.
legal.privacyIntro: This interim policy covers the OmniFit invite-only beta. We will publish a counsel-reviewed version before public marketing scale-up.
legal.privacyS1Body: Account details (name, email, phone), coaching content you or your clients enter (logs, messages, photos), and payment identifiers via Stripe when you enable in-app payouts. We do not sell personal data.
legal.privacyS2Body: To operate the product, deliver messaging and booking, process payments through Stripe, prevent abuse, and improve reliability. Progress photos use short-lived signed URLs.
legal.privacyS3Body: We share data with subprocessors required to run the service (e.g. Supabase hosting, Stripe). Coaches only see data for their paired clients under class-B isolation rules.
legal.privacyS4Body: You may update profile settings, request data export, or request account anonymization from Settings. Contact support@omnifit.app for privacy requests.
legal.termsIntro: By creating an OmniFit account you agree to these interim beta terms.
legal.termsS1Body: OmniFit provides software for coaches and invited clients. Features behind flags (marketplace, live video, Team) may be unavailable. We may change beta features with notice in-product.
legal.termsS2Body: You are responsible for your account credentials and for content you upload. Do not misuse the service, scrape data, or attempt unauthorized access.
legal.termsS3Body: Platform subscription (Pro) and acquisition invoices are billed to coaches. Client session payments on OmniFit go to your Stripe Connect account subject to Stripe's terms and OmniFit service fees disclosed in-app.
legal.termsS4Body: The beta is provided as-is. To the fullest extent permitted by law, OmniFit is not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service. Governing law will be stated in the final counsel-reviewed terms.
legal.counselNote: Interim beta copy pending counsel review. Contact support@omnifit.app for privacy or legal requests.
